plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Sell SMH to zero due to its downtrend and for capital preservation.
Trim SPY to 20% and QQQ to 10% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate limits.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Reduce SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Trim QQQI to 10% and CRWD to 10% to manage overall concentration.
Buy CRM, targeting 4% of the book, based on its strong scanner setup.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a diversified approach.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality tech name. Expect moderate volatility and a balanced risk-reward profile.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, targeting 6% each, to increase leveraged ETF exposure.
Increase CRWD to 15% to press a working position.
Buy MSFT and NVDA, targeting 5% each, based on their strong scanner setups.
Trim QQQ to 10% and SPY to 25% to manage overall concentration and meet mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth, stretching for higher returns. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of substantially higher drawdown risk and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs; strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Sell CRWD and SMH to zero, cutting high-beta single names.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30% of the book, to rotate into income-focused ETFs.
Trim SPY to 20% to manage broad index exposure and meet mandate limits.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth, rotating into income-generating ETFs. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
